why: Acting on a 1h signal before the constituent bar closed leaks the entire bar. It is the single most likely real leak in a 1m-constructed stack, because a naive resample stamps the bar at its open and every downstream join then looks correct.
The boundary case, as its own fixture. If acting at the close were rejected, every honest close-stamped strategy would fail Gate 0 and the check would be turned off within a week.

A label spanning 10 bars forward with a 2-bar purge means the last 8 training rows were labelled using data the test fold also contains. The model has seen the answer, the OOS score is inflated, and nothing in the equity curve looks wrong.
An edge that does not clear the minimum realistic cost is not an edge. This is the arithmetic form of the mistake; the lint fixture covers the code form (costs switched off outright).
